main_text.p: μεγάλα, spirantes grandia. At πλεῦτῶ ditesco, ζῶ vivo, ὑγιαίνω valeo, absoluta sunt.
Deponentium praeterita aliquando passivé significant, precipueq; participia, more Latinorum: μεμηχανη-μένος, molitus: ἐωνημένος, emptus: πεπολιτευμένος, administratus.

Communia, ut ἐργάζομαι τὴν γῆν, colo terra: ἡ γῆ ἐργάζεταί με, & terra colitur à me. Demosthenes, ὡς φαῦλον ὄν, ἀμιώμεθα, quód improbū non ulcifcimur. Idem, ὀρθῶς ἐγὼ λογίζομαι τοῦτο, bene ego ea ratiocinor. Isocrat. παραλογίζονται σφᾶς αὐτούς, decipiunt seipsos. Aristot. παραλογίζεται ἡ διάνοια αὐτῶν, decipitur mens ab ipsis.

page.notes: Greek passages are partly faint and were transcribed with uncertainty; the accents and some letters may not match the printed forms exactly. The word "Cap." at lower right is a catchword. Small marks in the left margin near line 'do passiué' are not legible text.
